BLK-04-ENGINE-TARGET-ALLOC-NAME-ERROR.defect_description: run_simulation() crashed with NameError: name 'target_alloc' is not defined in Step B morning entry execution loop.
BLK-04-ENGINE-TARGET-ALLOC-NAME-ERROR.remediation: Restored target_alloc = min(cash, current_equity * self.max_single_stock_pct) before share sizing calculation, preserving single-stock allocation cap (10%) and cash constraints.
BLK-04-ENGINE-TARGET-ALLOC-NAME-ERROR.verification: Verified via 10 isolated in-memory synthetic end-to-end integration tests without runtime error.

BLK-05-PROTOCOL-DSR-HURDLE-MISCALIBRATIO.amended_formula: SR_star_ann = sigma_SR * ((1 - gamma) * Phi_inv(1 - 1/K) + gamma * Phi_inv(1 - 1/(K * e)))
BLK-05-PROTOCOL-DSR-HURDLE-MISCALIBRATIO.defect_description: v1.0.0 hardcoded standard normal asymptotic extreme SR* = sqrt(2 * ln(16)) = 2.3548 without cross-sectional standard deviation sigma_SR of trial Sharpe ratios, requiring Annualized Net Sharpe > 3.54 to achieve p < 0.05 in sample T=490, guaranteeing 100% candidate rejection under Trigger R8.
BLK-05-PROTOCOL-DSR-HURDLE-MISCALIBRATIO.remediation: Formally amended protocol to Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014) formulation incorporating empirical cross-sectional dispersion sigma_SR across the K=16 validation trials. Documented conservative independent trial bound (K=16, EVT=1.8005) vs correlation diagnostics.
BLK-05-PROTOCOL-DSR-HURDLE-MISCALIBRATIO.verification: Verified via 15 independent synthetic numerical and edge-case statistical tests.
